# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made to the latest release only.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **don't** report security problems in a public issue. Use GitHub's
private vulnerability reporting (the
**Security** tab → **Report a vulnerability**), or email the maintainers at
<!-- add a contact address -->.

We aim to acknowledge reports within two weeks, and will tell you how we plan
to fix the problem.
